pages.text: The $(bold)consumer$() of activated fluid: the Life Centrifuge separates activated fuel into $(bold)activated crystals$() (one per fuel type) plus one $(bold)Exhausted Crystal$() by-product.$(br)Fluid becomes stackable solid crystals - no more endless stockpiling, and breaking never leaks waste.

$(bold)How it works:$()$(li)Input: activated fluid via normal fluid pipes (only activated fluid accepted)$(li)Separate: $(bold)50 Chishi Energy$() per mB, at $(bold)8 mB/tick$()$(li)Output: every $(bold)100 mB$() -> 1 matching activated crystal + 1 Exhausted Crystal$(br2)$(bold)Crystal uses:$() activated crystals upgrade identity cards (see "Wireless Identity Card"); Exhausted Crystals are the cost of the Item Reconstructor (see "Item Reconstructor").
